prompt:
I'm a PhD student in environmental science working on carbon sink dynamics in temperate forests. I've been using remote sensing (MODIS) data and need to publish my research in both a high-quality Chinese journal (at least 北大核心 or CSCD level) and an international SCI/SCIE-indexed journal. My budget is max CNY 3,000 for any Chinese publication fees and max USD 1,500 APC for international open-access options. I need this accepted within 8 months due to my graduation deadline.

Please generate a complete, professional journal advisory dossier for me — saved as `journal_dossier_carbon_forest.md` — that I can use immediately. It should cover both Chinese and international journal options, explain why each journal fits my research, tell me exactly how to approach writing for each one, and give me the submission paths I need. The dossier should also include any relevant service recommendations. I'm based at a northeast China university.
